description: Operator sends heartbeat with capability re-announcement. Keeps the kernel alive on the network and updates its own capability rows. Requires operate authority for this kernel: its recorded operator identity (the caller that registered it), its proven operator wallet, or the gateway admin authority. Another identity gets 403; no credentials gets 401; an unregistered kernel gets 404 for a non-admin. Operator identity proof for operate is completed by WP-A (DECISIONS items 136 and 138).
name: operator_heartbeat
